```{r setup}
library(nowaste)
```

```{r}
plot_plastic_density(plastic_data, variable = "plastic_per_capita")
```

This function creates a density plot showing the distribution of plastic waste per capita across countries.


```{r}
plastic_prop_type(plastic_data) 
```

This function gives the proportion of all plastic types for either the year or country. Can specify later. Prints in a table the make up of plastic and percentage for each tyep.
